tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists every seelig.ai service with id, price in CHF, duration in weeks, deliverable and page URL. Use the id with get_free_slots and request_booking.

tools.name: get_free_slots
tools.description: Returns free start times (ISO 8601, UTC offset included) for the free 30-minute video call about one service. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days apart, from today onward.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Requests the free 30-minute first call at one of the times from get_free_slots. Sends the person a confirmation email, which cannot be unsent. Nothing is booked until they confirm through the link in it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
